isolation: bubblewrap unshare-all; runtime/input read-only; private HOME/tmp; no host project or credentials mounted
checks: host sentinel unreadable and host TCP listener unreachable
baseline tarball installed and legacy assets deployed
invalid update rejected; previous CLI and owner files preserved
updating one worktree keeps the other worktree running its pinned old version
candidate update, legacy asset migration and idempotent reapply
installed CLI selects owner rules, omits bodies, detects changes and preserves settings
committed runtime runs in fresh worktree and clone without npm install or ASC_CLI
explicit old-version rollback and asset rollback preserve user data; mismatched launcher refused
uninstall removes external npm runtime; explicit missing override refused; default bundled runtime and owner files remain usable
reinstall restores execution without regenerating shared assets
shared external prefix updates do not stop default bundled execution in another worktree
second non-Git environment uses identical shared assets with a different installation prefix
deletionScope: npm runtime uninstall; shared project assets intentionally retained, not an automatic project-asset remover
failureScope: invalid archive before update; not disk-full, SIGKILL or power-loss atomicity
